newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen falling after merger collapse.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen falling after merger collapse.

text.p: Thai stocks are expected to fall on Monday following the collapse of a proposed merger between Thai Danu Bank Plc and ailing Finance One which would fuel sales of finance sector stocks, analysts said.
The SET Index finished 0.26 points lower at 581.13 on Friday. The SET 50 ended down 1.51 points at 42.36.

"I think the news about Finance One will dominate the market. Even if the shares are not traded it puts the other mergers in the sector in doubt, and may worry investors about other firms generally," said a foreign analyst at a Thai broker.
But the failure of the Finance One and Thai Danu Bank merger, announced last Friday, had been widely anticipated and damage could be somewhat limited, analysts said.

However it would outwweigh positive government export projections made over the weekend and expectations of a cut in interest rates expected to be signalled by the central bank at anytime, they added.
"The merger failure was widely anticipated it may help limit the impact but the Thai Danu, Fin One issue will still have a psycholgical affect," said a trader at General Finance.
